description: This file defines the TraceModel class and related types and functions for managing and analyzing trace data in a Playwright testing environment. It includes methods for constructing action trees, filtering actions, collecting source code information, and handling timing adjustments between library and test runner contexts.

classes.name: TraceModel
classes.description: Represents a comprehensive model of a trace, including actions, events, resources, sources, and related metadata, with methods for analysis and manipulation.

methods.name: createRelativeUrl
methods.description: Generates a relative URL for the trace with trace URI as a query parameter.

methods.name: failedAction
methods.description: Returns the innermost action that contains an error.

methods.name: filteredActions
methods.description: Filters actions based on provided action groups.

methods.name: renderActionTree
methods.description: Builds a visual representation of the action hierarchy, optionally filtered by action groups.

methods.name: _errorDescriptorsFromTestRunner
methods.description: Collects error descriptions from test runner errors.
